reference.capture: live tmux input with stable screen capture and sanitized history-file readback

normalization: Temporary checkout and synthetic HERMES_HOME paths are represented by placeholders.
Timestamps, session IDs, elapsed seconds, rotating prompt suggestions, and dynamic working-directory text are omitted or represented by placeholders.
The busy face is normalized to the stable Ctrl+C interrupt affordance; editor process output and terminal control sequences are not part of the contract.
Editor file content records use explicit \n and <trailing newline> notation; history samples replace generated timestamp comments with <timestamp>.
Input bytes are recorded in hexadecimal after tmux key translation.
The fixture records deterministic editor outcomes only and does not imply complete interactive-editor parity.

steps.precondition: Fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME and ready composer with EDITOR replaced by a deterministic command that writes edited-one\nedited-two\n and exits 0.
Fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME and ready composer with EDITOR replacing the temporary file with two logical lines and a trailing newline, then exiting 0.

output.newline_behavior: internal newline preserved; one trailing newline removed before submission

steps.precondition: Fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME and ready composer with EDITOR writing two lines where the first line ends with two spaces and the file ends with a newline, then exiting 0.

output.trim_behavior: trimEnd removes the final newline but preserves spaces before an internal newline
